visualCharacteristics.stylingNotes: Rounded 16px light-blue panel, centred text. Heading 48px (32px mobile) bold black with superscript SM; description 18px (16px) #1d2329; legal 12px (11px) #454b52 with underlined link; outline pill CTA 48px high, 2px #00388f border, 28px radius, 14px bold. Image banner: photo covers a 500px-high rounded panel (object-fit cover), text left max 595px, white text, eyebrow 26px (22px mobile), light #f2fafd pill with #00388f text; mobile stacks the mobile photo above dark text and a filled #00388f pill.
visualCharacteristics.purpose: Advertise an AT&T offer (att.com) on the newsroom
visualCharacteristics.description: Centred offer banner with heading, description, legal line and outline button

contentPattern.summary: att.com multi-cta offer strip (data-comp=multi-cta-duc): h2 heading-xxl, p type-base, div type-legal with 'See offer details', btn-secondary CTA. Image banner: business.att.com hero-panel offer (eyebrow, h2, description, legal, CTA over a data-desktop / data-mobile background photo).
contentPattern.structure: One cell: optional photo(s) (desktop, then mobile), optional eyebrow paragraph, heading, description paragraph, legal paragraph(s), link-only paragraph(s) as buttons
